Solver.Description: Solver of the MATLAB ode object (a solver for DAEs)

Tolerance.Description: Relative error tolerance, 'RelativeTolerance' of the ode object (1e-15 <= tol <= 1e-3)

AbsoluteTolerance.Description: Absolute error tolerance, 'AbsoluteTolerance' of the ode object (1e-15 <= tol <= 1e-3)

MaxStep.Description: [s] Largest step of the solver; NaN for the solver default

InitialStep.Description: [s] First step of each phase; NaN for the solver default

SampleTime.Description: [s] Interval of the recorded times on a uniform grid from the start time; the start and end of each phase are also recorded. NaN or 0 records the steps of the solver

StopOnOutOfStep.Description: Stop the simulation when the rotor angle of a generator from the generator of the slack bus exceeds StopAngle (flag = 2)

StopAngle.Description: [deg] Threshold of StopOnOutOfStep: largest allowed absolute rotor angle from the reference

SeparateComplexParts.Description: SeparateComplexParts property of the MATLAB ode object (true: 'on', false: 'off')

TimeLimit.Description: [s] Limit of the computation time of the whole run. When exceeded, the simulation stops and returns the result up to the time reached (flag = 0). A value that is not positive means no limit.

Verbose.Description: Print the phases before the integration and the outcome after it

PlotFcn.Description: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.plot_trajectory()
